References to helpful resources for canc.Explanation: The American Cancer Society Survivorship Center provides comprehensive resources and support for cancer survivors, which can help the patient manage their health and well-being during follow-up care. This recommendation is based on the need to provide survivors with appropriate resources to meet their information needs related to breast cancer, its treatment, side effects, other health concerns, and available support services.

The ASCO survivor and caregiver site offers valuable information and resources for cancer survivors and their caregivers. This can be beneficial for the patient to understand more about their condition, ongoing treatments, and potential side effects, as well as to find support services.

Journey Forward provides tools and resources to help cancer survivors manage their follow-up care and improve their quality of life. This resource is recommended to help the patient build a survivorship care plan and access support services.
The NCCN patient and caregiver resources offer guidelines and support for cancer survivors, which can help the patient navigate their ongoing treatment and manage any side effects or health concerns.
